Ivory Silk Pashmina Blend Scarf

₹4,999

The silk weft gives this scarf a faint sheen and enough drape to knot cleanly, while the pashm warp keeps it warm.

Blending silk into Pashmina is not a compromise — it is how Kashmiri weavers have made summer-weight cloth for over a century.

The result takes dye differently across warp and weft, producing a subtle two-tone shimmer as it moves.
